title: [2.8.0] AAPS Crashes/stops 1-2 times a day
body:
Hi,

since Updating AAPS from 2.7.0 to 2.8.0 I noticed, that it crashes once or twice a day. This happened never with 2.7.0

I did not change anything on the system, just the App Update.

Android 9, Sony Xperia Compact XZ2
Dexcom G6 (patched APP) (sending through AAPS, which sends to xdrip+)
Accu-Chek Combo

the following happens: I notice that xdrip+ doesn't receive bg values anymore and I open AAPS on the phone. Than it is the same behavior like a phone restart. AAPS initializes again and the BOLUS, INSULIN and Calculator do not appear. The pump is again being initialized and after the connection worked, the three Buttons appear again.

In the logs there is nothing special I think. You see an hour of no entries, which shows that AAPS crashed/stopped nearly an hour before.
